name: task_assign
description: Assign a user (the 'assignee' / 'executor') to an existing task in z-task. A task can have multiple assignees. Backed by POST /api/task/assignees/add. Use this when the CEO agent needs to delegate a task to a dev agent / human / sub-team. Note: 'userId' is the z-ctc username (not a numeric id), typically in the form 'staff_no' like 'zifang' or 'dev-agent-01'. Returns success boolean. To UN-assign, use the corresponding removeAssignee endpoint (not wrapped as a skill yet).

taskId.description: Numeric task id. Use task_create (response) or list endpoints to obtain.

userId.description: z-ctc username of the assignee. Examples: 'zifang' (CEO), 'dev-agent-001', 'content-agent'.
